text: - RIs are also effective and patients unresponsive to one SSRI may respond to another. SSRIs are also of use in the treatment of gen- eralised anxiety disorder (p.952), panic disorder (p.952), and post-traumatic stress disorder (p.953). SSRIs are considered to be the first choice for the treatment of social anxiety disorder (see under Phobic Disorders, p.953). Fluoxetine is one of the SSRIs that has been tried in the treatment of trichotillomania. References. 1. Tollefson GD, et al.
